analysis_walkthrough.business_objective_summary: Modernize the Sweet Bank Kotlin banking application by analyzing its Kotlin-specific patterns, module structure, and coroutine usage.
requirements_understanding: The application is built using Kotlin and requires modernization.
Focus on Kotlin-specific patterns, module structure, and coroutine usage.
Ensure backward compatibility and legacy behavior preservation.
conversion_to_technical_requirements: Analyze Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous operations.
Review module structure for maintainability and scalability.
Ensure compliance with banking standards and protocols.
clarifications_requested: Are there specific modernization goals beyond analysis, such as performance improvements or feature additions?
What is the current deployment environment and are there any constraints?

outputSnapshot.executive_summary: The project aims to modernize the Sweet Bank Kotlin application by analyzing and enhancing its Kotlin-specific architecture and coroutine usage.

functional_requirements.title: Analyze Kotlin Coroutine Usage
functional_requirements.description: Evaluate and optimize the use of Kotlin coroutines for asynchronous operations in the application.
acceptance_criteria: Identify all coroutine usage points in the codebase.
Ensure coroutine usage aligns with best practices for performance and readability.
Document any changes made to coroutine implementations.

functional_requirements.title: Review Module Structure
functional_requirements.description: Assess the current module structure for maintainability and suggest improvements.
acceptance_criteria: Complete a structural analysis of all modules.
Provide a report with recommendations for restructuring.
Implement approved structural changes.

functional_requirements.title: Ensure Backward Compatibility
functional_requirements.description: Maintain backward compatibility with existing interfaces and data contracts.
acceptance_criteria: Identify all existing interfaces and data contracts.
Verify that no existing functionality is broken post-modernization.
Conduct regression testing to confirm compatibility.

functional_requirements.title: Implement Idempotency for Financial Operations
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all financial operations are idempotent to prevent duplicate transactions.
acceptance_criteria: Implement Idempotency-Key header for all financial operations.
Persist key + payload hash + response tuple with TTL.
Return 409 for same key with divergent payload.

functional_requirements.title: Audit Logging for State Changes
functional_requirements.description: Implement audit logging for all privileged and financial state changes.
acceptance_criteria: Log all state changes with correlation_id, trace_id, and actor_id.
Ensure logs are tamper-evident and stored securely.
Verify logs meet compliance requirements.

functional_requirements.title: PII Redaction in Logs
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all logs redact PII and regulated payment fields.
acceptance_criteria: Implement centralized redaction middleware.
Define allowlist fields for support and analytics views.
Verify no PII is exposed in production logs.

functional_requirements.title: Compliance with ISO 20022
functional_requirements.description: Ensure all payment payloads comply with ISO 20022 standards.
acceptance_criteria: Validate payment payload structure against canonical message schema.
Use deterministic field mapping and explicit validation errors.
Retain original inbound/outbound message payloads for audit evidence.

functional_requirements.title: Implement FIX Protocol Baseline
functional_requirements.description: Ensure message sequencing and replay protection using FIX Protocol.
acceptance_criteria: Enforce message sequencing for all relevant operations.
Capture deterministic routing/acknowledgement states in logs.
Verify compliance with FIX Protocol standards.

non_functional_requirements.title: Performance Optimization
non_functional_requirements.description: Optimize the application for improved performance, focusing on coroutine usage.
acceptance_criteria: Measure current performance metrics.
Implement optimizations and measure improvements.
Ensure no degradation in performance post-optimization.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalability Enhancement
non_functional_requirements.description: Enhance the application's scalability to handle increased load.
non_functional_requirements.metric: Support 2x current user load without performance degradation
acceptance_criteria: Conduct load testing to establish baseline.
Implement scalability improvements.
Verify application performance under increased load.

non_functional_requirements.title: Security Compliance
non_functional_requirements.description: Ensure the application complies with security standards and best practices.
acceptance_criteria: Conduct a security audit of the application.
Implement necessary security improvements.
Verify compliance with security standards.

non_functional_requirements.title: Reliability Improvement
non_functional_requirements.description: Improve the application's reliability and reduce downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Identify current reliability issues.
Implement improvements to address issues.
Monitor and verify improved uptime metrics.

non_functional_requirements.title: Usability Enhancement
non_functional_requirements.description: Enhance the usability of the application for end-users.
acceptance_criteria: Conduct user surveys to gather feedback.
Implement usability improvements based on feedback.
Re-evaluate user satisfaction post-implementation.

blocking.question: Target UI framework selection for migrated forms
blocking.default_recommendation: WinForms for lowest event-model delta from VB6 unless UX redesign is in scope.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: High rework risk in form/event parity and control migration.

blocking.question: ActiveX/OCX replacement strategy by dependency
blocking.default_recommendation: Replace common controls and isolate only high-risk dependencies behind adapters.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Runtime regressions and release delays from unresolved control behavior.

blocking.question: Database contract strategy during migration
blocking.default_recommendation: Preserve contracts initially and modernize behind a compatibility layer.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Business rule drift and data-side regressions.

blocking.question: Confirm identity/access model (role model, multi-user assumptions, and credential handling).
blocking.default_recommendation: Define target role model and credential policy before implementation.

blocking.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?
blocking.default_recommendation: Resolve with product/business owner before implementation commitment.

blocking.question: Ground BDD acceptance criteria in real legacy golden flows before Build planning.
blocking.default_recommendation: Regenerate BDD from validated golden flows, route evidence, and SQL touchpoints before Build starts.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Acceptance criteria will not validate real legacy behavior, creating parity and release risk.

blocking.question: Confirm the compliance/privacy framework that governs contractor onboarding, placement, and offboarding flows.
blocking.default_recommendation: Map staffing-domain controls (for example credential handling, audit logging, COBRA/offboarding notifications, and wage/hour or background-screening obligations) into requirements and tests before Build.
blocking.impact_if_wrong: Build may preserve workflow parity but still miss regulatory obligations and audit controls.

non_blocking.question: Logging and observability stack for migrated runtime
non_blocking.default_recommendation: OpenTelemetry + structured logs for parity troubleshooting.
